title: INSEAD Scholarships (Master in Management, MBA and Master in Finance)
program_type: Merit and need-based tuition scholarships awarded to admitted INSEAD Master's and MBA candidates
duration: One admission cycle, aligned to the MIM, MBA or MIF programme the candidate is admitted to.
description: INSEAD Scholarships is the school's own financial aid portfolio for its MBA, Master in Management and Master in Finance programmes, comprising more than 170 funds with an average award of EUR 24,000. Awards are split between need-based, merit-based, geography-based, diversity, women's and spot categories, and 38% of students receive support. Application is through the same Application Online platform used for admission.

title: ENS de Lyon Scholarships of Excellence (Ampère and GRADUATE +)
program_type: Monthly merit-based stipend for international students entering an ENS de Lyon Master's programme
duration: Ampère: 12 months (renewable under conditions). GRADUATE +: 10 months (renewable in M2 for a further 10 months subject to selection and validation of Year 1).

title: Barcelona School of Economics Master's Tuition Funding and Scholarships
program_type: Merit-based tuition-fee waivers and named full scholarships for BSE Master's students
duration: One Master's programme cycle; funding is assessed with the admission offer.

title: IE University Master's Awards and Scholarships
program_type: Merit-based tuition awards and merit-plus-need tuition awards for admitted master's students
duration: One admission cycle; awards are assessed together with the admission decision.

title: Esade Talent Scholarships (MSc and MBA)
program_type: Merit and need-based tuition scholarships plus room-and-board grants for Esade students
duration: MSc and MBA Talent Scholarships cover the official MBA and MSc programmes; Degree Talent Scholarships run for the entire undergraduate or double-degree programme.
description: Esade's Scholarship Program funds academically excellent students with limited financial resources. MSc and MBA Talent Scholarships (published as Esade Need-based Scholarships) cover 50% to 85% of the programme tuition fee and are assessed on talent and financial need. Esade also runs Excellence Awards, which are talent-only, range from 10% to 50% of MSc tuition, and are limited to one award per candidate. Living costs are handled separately through Lodging, Living, Exchange and SUD grants.
